thought.text: MailDev 3.0.0 seems to have different routes. Let me probe it properly and test SMTP inside the network.

reasoning_content:
Maildev: The API `/api/emails` returned 404, and from inside the container the `/healthz` file was empty (cat /healthz failed, and the output got mixed in). The health check test is `wget -O - http://127.0.0.1:1080/healthz`, but the container is reporting unhealthy. In MailDev 3.0.0, the health check endpoint may have been changed. Let me check the actual MailDev 3 endpoints. In MailDev 2.x, the endpoints were `/api/emails`, `/api/emails/newest`, `/healthz`. In MailDev 3.0.0, the API may have been changed. Let me check which routes exist: the web UI at `/` returned 404 on the host?? Wait a minute—when I curl'd http://localhost:1080/ earlier it returned 404. But the logs say "MailDev API running at http://localhost:1080". Hmm, but the Web Interface port... In MailDev 3, the Web interface was moved to port 80? No, that's not right. Let me look at the logs more closely: "SMTP Server Address: :: Port: 1025, Web Interface" is cut off mid-way. Let me get the complete logs.

Actually, in MailDev 3.0.0, the API endpoints may have been restructured. Let me test a few paths: `/api/v2/emails`? Let me check the actual routes. MailDev 3.0 (released 2025?)—I recall that MailDev 3.0.0 was a major rewrite. Let me check the Web interface.

The SMTP connection to localhost:1025 was refused from the host—that's as expected. SMTP 1025 is not exposed to the host (only 1080 is exposed). From the compose file: ports: '1080:1080'. So SMTP can only be reached from the Docker network. That's not a problem—the guide says maildev: 1080 (Web). Let me test the SMTP port inside the container.

Let me investigate MailDev's Web interface properly.

action.command: docker logs startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1 2>&1 | tail -10; echo "=== probe routes ==="; for p in / /home /api/emails /emails /api/v2/emails; do printf "%s -> " "$p"; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:1080$p"; done; echo "=== SMTP inside container ==="; docker exec startuphafen-devcontainer-maildev-1 sh -c 'printf "QUIT\r\n" | timeout 5 bash -c "cat < /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/1025" 2>/dev/null || (echo QUIT | timeout 5 nc 127.0.0.1 1025 2>/dev/null)' 2>&1 | head -3
